resolution_notes: base_url: Corrected to https://coveralls.io/api/v1; the current official API introduction identifies /api/v1/repos and /api/v1/jobs as its endpoint URIs: https://docs.coveralls.io/api-introduction. example: Corrected because the original undocumented collection GET and invented response are not supported by the cited docs. The replacement request and response are the official working POST /jobs examples; coverage.json must contain repo_token and coverage data: https://docs.coveralls.io/api-jobs-endpoint.
